findings.issue: Stage 1 operator instruction says 'вставь синтетическую zombie-строку в `bot_test/news.db`' without the full server path. The correct path on VPS is `/home/hwbot/bot_test/news.db`. An operator who SSHes in at the wrong working directory could interpret `bot_test/news.db` as relative to `$HOME` or current dir, causing confusion.
findings.fix: Change to the full absolute path: 'вставь синтетическую zombie-строку в `/home/hwbot/bot_test/news.db`' to match deployment.md convention.
